name: Precision Channel Strip (UAD-2)
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: a VST-wrapped UAD-2 plugin, so every knob reports only its 0-1 position; values go through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.
Five EQ bands into the four shared ones: LF1 = low, MF = low mid, HF1 = high mid, HF2 = high. LF2 is not mapped. The Flt/Q knobs mix a shelf setting and a Q, so band types and HF1 Q are not mapped.
Output is the dynamics output level (Dyn Lvl), after the EQ.
Table built 2026-11-23; switch labels confirmed. Ratio tops out at INF.
